measurements.package_list_2026_10_22: package_list: 3,831 packages. Provider prefix counts: censtatd 935, hkma 198, swd 167, lcsd 124, landsd 119, emsd 100, immd 88, dh 81, wsd 72, edb 71, dpo 65, td 60, epd 59, hko 57, afcd 56 - dominated by aggregate statistical tables.
measurements.event_grain_sweep_2026_10_22: Keyword sweep over package names: 'accident' -> Transport Dept annual road traffic accident tables 2018-2024 (aggregate XLSX/CSV) and Marine Dept marine accident statistics; 'incident' -> EMSD lift/escalator/gas incident STATISTICS (the 'Reported Lift Incident Records' CSV measured at 43 rows: Year x Main Cause x Count, annual aggregate); 'burst' -> WSD annual water main burst CSV + one CSDI geoportal layer of individual burst cases; 'prosecut' -> ICAC/Customs quarterly-by-sector aggregates.
measurements.wsd_burst_case_2026_10_22: The only per-case dataset found: WSD 'Report of Main Burst Case' (hk-wsd-wsd9-report-of-main-burst-case), served as a CSDI geoportal layer (wsd_rcd_...). Positives-only (burst cases with location, pipe size, date); no pipe-network inventory covariates are exposed on the portal, so a supervised population cannot be defined from the portal alone.

rejection_reason: Parked on task-family grounds, with access and licence settled: the anonymous CKAN API works (3,831 packages enumerated) and the portal terms permit redistribution with attribution (class B), but the catalogue is dominated by aggregate statistical series (Censtatd 935/3,831) in families the bench has already built or parked twice (statcan-wds-aggregate-series, ons-la-claimant-count-direction), and the event-grain leads each map onto an existing bench family or a known mirror: WSD weekly reservoir storage (= the tw-reservoir-drought family), HKO tropical-cyclone best track (= the TCRISI/TCBench mirror precedent that dropped jma-typhoon-rapid-intensification), EMSD/WSD/ICAC incident and prosecution series (annual/quarterly aggregates), Censtatd hospital tables (NHS A&E family, dropped there as a negative result). No dataset supports a task the bench does not already carry.
next_action: Unpark only by operator decision, same shape as the Singapore catalog park: (a) accept a second own-history environmental-exceedance family member (cleanest candidate: WSD Storage Position of Impounding Reservoirs, weekly CSVs, anonymous), or (b) accept an aggregate-statistics family member (ICAC corruption complaints/prosecutions by sector, quarterly), or (c) name a specific event-grain dataset and fund the off-portal join (WSD burst cases + pipe network covariates) as a construction.
